title: The agent said "task complete" — the email was still there
question: The agent said "task complete" — the email was still there
hook: An AI agent reported "Email account RESET completed" — and the email it was asked to delete still sat on the server, while the owner's entire mail setup was gone.
core_idea: an agent's completion report describes its local model of the world, not the world — so validating consequence systems means checking world state independently and gating irreversible actions, because nothing else will notice the contradiction.
visual_object: a split screen — the agent's thought-bubble world vs the actual mailbox — drifting apart step by step
prerequisites: what an autonomous agent is (LLM with tools)
exclusions: no OpenClaw architecture, no taxonomy tour, no other Agents-of-Chaos cases, no responsibility debate
